notes.title: November 9th patch
notes.content: Adjusted kill-zones in the suburban area. Some kill-zones were a bit too close to the walkable areas on top of the pipes.

notes.title: November 8th update
notes.content: Removed a debug feature that was accidentally left in the public branch.

notes.title: November 7th Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the collectable drinks disappeared if you tried the Endurance mode before the Arcade mode. 
Sorry about that!
